readerNotes.line: Traced along the heavy ticked line from the top edge, around Aachen and Monschau, the Malmedy shoulder, west to the Amblève near the 30th and 82d, back east around the 106th, west to the Bastogne front and the Wiltz hairpin, then through Luxembourg to the Moselle and southeast to the east edge. Points are sampled evenly along the line.
